⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧テープ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{録|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し→引越し：03704_hikkoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{段|だん}ボール→段ボール：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ガムテープ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦とめた→留める：10053_tomeru⟧。
examples.english: When moving, I sealed the cardboard boxes with packing tape.

notes:
テープ is a loanword from English "tape," referring to various types of adhesive or recording tape.

COMMON TYPES:
- セロテープ: cellophane tape (clear tape)
- ガムテープ: packing tape, duct tape
- カセットテープ: cassette tape
- ビデオテープ: video tape
- マスキングテープ: masking tape

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- テープで{貼|は}る: to stick with tape
- テープを{切|き}る: to cut the tape (also: ribbon cutting)
- テープに{録|と}る: to record on tape

NOTE:
セロテープ is a brand name (like "Scotch tape") but commonly used generically in Japan. For "adhesive tape" in general, {粘着|ねんちゃく}テープ is the technical term.
